title: Concerto for Two Violins in D minor: II. Largo ma non tanto
video_use_ideas: One of Bach's most loved slow movements: warm, intertwined lines for a heartfelt moment.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 3 ('Concerto in D minor for two violins and strings', for Violin Duet and String Orchestra: Two Violins, Viola, 'Cello); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter David Chan). Edition source: Bach Gesellschaft zu Leipzig, 1874. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
